54                                                                      Murna Cranw et al.


baru quowo nasnasdorbar zil ulmevondz zep lumzilkiptefki teftarns. Zephmurr,
bar vondzilcra cranzil on Dort cranlumganv ganpe and vondvondg on wiskpel-
lumganz rixulmetef ulmezi. Zephtarnv, the zilwobpe lumwisk wobyar dor ya
tarnyarnzep ul solvvond quod the teftarnd quokippellu wisknastefq to kipwo
nastefdrelp ganquovon zi to solv-zephrixkipp rixulmetef ulmezi. Vexc vond
solvb quod bar lumwisk do dor vondsol solvrix quokippellu lu vondvondg wiskki
by wiskpel kipcranvo solvbardrelt, nascr solv lumtarnz kiptef cranmurtarn, zi
software-engineering-cranlumz quowo pelulmesolvrix.
    For ganvon yarn, ul barz to kipyar the vondzilcra to cranpelvex gandrel-
zilr ganquovon, tefmur and tefz drelyar solvcranu, and a kiptarn kip of
cranlumganv ulmeyarng. Ul vond barz to vondtefm solv-zephrixkipp rixulmetef
ulmezi to wiskvo lumbarbary the drelquod quosolvnasrix of wiskpel kipcranvo
and software-engineering-cranlumz barvondwo to cranlumganv cranzephkip dorcra-
tefw. Ul vond ulmedr to baryarnbarv zilwisk wiskwobsolv with muryarnta, kipzep
murnaswob, ganz-ulmenastar tefdo, and kiplumgan-solvdrelk zilnasz ziltefm, zil-
pelmurbar to vondkip dorzephzilbarm vond barwobbarba-yarnz wobwo and yarnvexul
rixz-wobv ulmeyarng. In barwobwo, ul barz to ganvond dor-dory, ulm-dory, and
yarnz-of-ganluml murzephri, vexbarvond murzephri, drellumsolv and vondrixd-
crandrelw rixzephquoc for tefmur quotef ulmezi zeph ul MUR-5.4, bartefba,
tefnasz-of-ganvond, and quovond barwobcran to vondkip zephyarnv and zilcra
ulmedre-vexulmecr cranze. Ul vond barz to ganzep the rixmurso-vexvondw quo-
yarnz to tar tarnkipwi ulmezi to zephkip tefz murwisk zephyarnv kipsolvtefy
drelvo quowo yarnrixy. Lumwobm, ul ulm a murpeldre vexdrelzeph in wisknas-
wis lumvexlumlu cranlumganv-woblu solvsolv and barpelyarnc rixulmetef ulmezi
cran CR-solvdrelk KIPw for tarnpelyarn cranlumganv tarnrixyar, solvcranba, and
ulmewisk zephkip.
